summary: Catai is a local LLM chat app (React UI served by the catai server). Each view starts at /seed.html, which loads the seeded chat history and then redirects to /. I saved three views: (1) chat-conversation: the main workspace with the sidebar (connection status, New Chat, Settings, search, recent chats) and an open conversation, with the model's thinking expanded, a markdown reply with a highlighted code block, and the message box; (2) settings-model: the Settings dialog on the Model Settings tab, which shows the JSON settings editor; (3) settings-builtin-apis: the Settings dialog on the Built-in APIs tab, with its list of checkbox cards. I skipped the System Prompt tab (a text box with buttons, too close to the Model Settings tab in layout), the empty "Start a Conversation" screen, and the filtered chat search (same layout as the main view). I didn't send any new messages, because that would add data every time a view is replayed.
